projects.name: PetCare Hub
bullets: Built and deployed a two-sided marketplace connecting pet owners with service providers, including authentication, pet management, provider profiles, availability, bookings, and reviews.
Implemented server-validated booking workflows and database authorization using Supabase Auth and PostgreSQL Row Level Security.
Designed relational data models and protected owner/provider workflows while maintaining a responsive production UI.

projects.name: GigMate
bullets: Built a full-stack dashboard for tracking gig sessions, mileage, expenses, estimated taxes, cash profit, take-home pay, and effective hourly rate.
Developed a centralized financial calculation engine with automated tests covering core earnings and expense calculations.
Implemented authentication, persistent user settings, database security policies, analytics, filtering, and data visualization.

projects.name: NeighborLink
bullets: Built a local marketplace with listings, image uploads, search and filtering, favorites, user authentication, and direct messaging.
Implemented database-backed messaging with unread states and user-scoped marketplace data.
Developed responsive listing creation, browsing, detail, and account workflows backed by Supabase.

experience.title: Trailer & Reefer Technician
bullets: Diagnose and repair electrical, mechanical, refrigeration, braking, and trailer systems in a production service environment.

Use diagnostic information, schematics, testing equipment, and hands-on inspection to identify fault causes and resolve repairs accurately, applying systematic problem-solving relevant to development work.
Manage repairs independently while documenting work, communicating findings, and prioritizing safe, reliable equipment operation.
